def dot_rows(left,right):
 return np.sum(left*right,axis=-1)
def point_segment_sq(points,start,end):
 direction=end-start
 parameter=np.clip(dot_rows(points-start,direction)/dot_rows(direction,direction),0,1)
 residual=points-start-parameter[...,None]*direction
 return dot_rows(residual,residual)
def point_triangle_sq(points,triangles):
 origin=triangles[:,0]; edge_u=triangles[:,1]-origin; edge_v=triangles[:,2]-origin
 normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); normal_sq=dot_rows(normal,normal)
 offset=points-origin
 height=dot_rows(offset,normal)
 projected=offset-height[:,None]/normal_sq[:,None]*normal
 uu=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_u); uv=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_v); vv=dot_rows(edge_v,edge_v)
 pu=dot_rows(projected,edge_u); pv=dot_rows(projected,edge_v)
 determinant=dot_rows(normal,normal)
 bary_u=(pu*vv-pv*uv)/determinant
 bary_v=(pv*uu-pu*uv)/determinant
 inside=(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)
 distance=np.minimum.reduce([point_segment_sq(points,triangles[:,idx],triangles[:,(idx+1)%3]) for idx in range(3)])
 return np.where(inside,np.minimum(distance,height*height/normal_sq),distance)
def segments_sq(start_a,end_a,start_b,end_b):
 direction_a=end_a-start_a;direction_b=end_b-start_b;offset=start_a-start_b
 aa=dot_rows(direction_a,direction_a);bb=dot_rows(direction_a,direction_b);cc=dot_rows(direction_b,direction_b)
 dd=dot_rows(direction_a,offset);ee=dot_rows(direction_b,offset)
 determinant=aa*cc-bb*bb
 stable=determinant>1e-14*aa*cc
 safe=np.where(stable,determinant,1)
 param_a=(bb*ee-cc*dd)/safe;param_b=(aa*ee-bb*dd)/safe
 interior=stable&(param_a>=0)&(param_a<=1)&(param_b>=0)&(param_b<=1)
 residual=offset+param_a[:,None]*direction_a-param_b[:,None]*direction_b
 endpoint=np.minimum.reduce([point_segment_sq(start_a,start_b,end_b),point_segment_sq(end_a,start_b,end_b),point_segment_sq(start_b,start_a,end_a),point_segment_sq(end_b,start_a,end_a)])
 return np.where(interior,np.minimum(endpoint,dot_rows(residual,residual)),endpoint)
def segment_triangle_hit(start,end,triangles):

 normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v);direction=end-start
 denominator=dot_rows(direction,normal)
 valid=np.abs(denominator)>1e-14*np.sqrt(dot_rows(direction,direction)*dot_rows(normal,normal))
 parameter=dot_rows(origin-start,normal)/np.where(valid,denominator,1)

 uu=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_u);uv=dot_rows(edge_u,edge_v);vv=dot_rows(edge_v,edge_v)
 pu=dot_rows(offset,edge_u);pv=dot_rows(offset,edge_v)

 return valid&(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1)&(bary_u>=0)&(bary_v>=0)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1)
def surface_distance(tris_a,tris_b):

 repeated_a=np.repeat(tris_a,count_b,axis=0);repeated_b=np.tile(tris_b,(count_a,1,1))

  hits|=segment_triangle_hit(repeated_a[:,edge_idx],repeated_a[:,(edge_idx+1)%3],repeated_b)

def dot_last(left,right):
 return np.sum(left*right,axis=-1)

def point_segment_sq(point,start,end):
 direction=end-start
 denom=dot_last(direction,direction)
 parameter=np.divide(dot_last(point-start,direction),denom,out=np.zeros(np.broadcast_shapes(point.shape[:-1],denom.shape)),where=denom>0)
 parameter=np.clip(parameter,0,1)
 residual=point-start-parameter[...,None]*direction
 return dot_last(residual,residual)

def point_triangle_sq(point,triangle):
 start=triangle[...,0,:]; side_a=triangle[...,1,:]-start; side_b=triangle[...,2,:]-start
 normal=np.cross(side_a,side_b); normal_sq=dot_last(normal,normal)
 offset=point-start
 signed=dot_last(offset,normal)
 aa=dot_last(side_a,side_a); ab=dot_last(side_a,side_b); bb=dot_last(side_b,side_b)
 pa=dot_last(offset,side_a); pb=dot_last(offset,side_b)
 denom=aa*bb-ab*ab
 coord_a=np.divide(bb*pa-ab*pb,denom,out=np.zeros_like(pa),where=denom>0)
 coord_b=np.divide(aa*pb-ab*pa,denom,out=np.zeros_like(pb),where=denom>0)
 inside=(denom>0)&(coord_a>=0)&(coord_b>=0)&(coord_a+coord_b<=1)
 plane_sq=np.divide(signed*signed,normal_sq,out=np.full_like(signed,np.inf),where=normal_sq>0)
 result=np.where(inside,plane_sq,np.inf)
 for edge in range(3):
  result=np.minimum(result,point_segment_sq(point,triangle[...,edge,:],triangle[...,(edge+1)%3,:]))
 return result

def segment_triangle_hit(start,end,triangle):
 base=triangle[...,0,:]; side_a=triangle[...,1,:]-base; side_b=triangle[...,2,:]-base
 normal=np.cross(side_a,side_b)
 initial=dot_last(start-base,normal); change=dot_last(end-start,normal)
 parameter=np.divide(-initial,change,out=np.full_like(initial,np.inf),where=change!=0)
 valid=(parameter>=0)&(parameter<=1)&(change!=0)
 point=start+np.where(valid,parameter,0)[...,None]*(end-start)
 offset=point-base
 aa=dot_last(side_a,side_a); ab=dot_last(side_a,side_b); bb=dot_last(side_b,side_b)
 pa=dot_last(offset,side_a); pb=dot_last(offset,side_b); denom=aa*bb-ab*ab
 coord_a=np.divide(bb*pa-ab*pb,denom,out=np.zeros_like(pa),where=denom>0)
 coord_b=np.divide(aa*pb-ab*pa,denom,out=np.zeros_like(pb),where=denom>0)
 return valid&(denom>0)&(coord_a>=0)&(coord_b>=0)&(coord_a+coord_b<=1)

def triangle_surface_distance(triangles_a,triangles_b):
 origin=triangles_a[0,0].copy()
 first=(triangles_a-origin)[:,None,:,:]
 second=(triangles_b-origin)[None,:,:,:]
 distance_sq=np.full((len(triangles_a),len(triangles_b)),np.inf)
 hits=np.zeros(distance_sq.shape,dtype=bool)
 for vertex in range(3):
  distance_sq=np.minimum(distance_sq,point_triangle_sq(first[...,vertex,:],second))
  distance_sq=np.minimum(distance_sq,point_triangle_sq(second[...,vertex,:],first))
  hits|=segment_triangle_hit(first[...,vertex,:],first[...,(vertex+1)%3,:],second)
  hits|=segment_triangle_hit(second[...,vertex,:],second[...,(vertex+1)%3,:],first)
 for edge_a in range(3):
  start_a=first[...,edge_a,:]; direction_a=first[...,(edge_a+1)%3,:]-start_a
  for edge_b in range(3):
   start_b=second[...,edge_b,:]; direction_b=second[...,(edge_b+1)%3,:]-start_b
   offset=start_a-start_b
   aa=dot_last(direction_a,direction_a); bb=dot_last(direction_b,direction_b); ab=dot_last(direction_a,direction_b)
   ao=dot_last(direction_a,offset); bo=dot_last(direction_b,offset)
   denom=aa*bb-ab*ab
   param_a=np.divide(ab*bo-bb*ao,denom,out=np.zeros_like(ao),where=denom>1e-14*aa*bb)
   param_b=np.divide(aa*bo-ab*ao,denom,out=np.zeros_like(bo),where=denom>1e-14*aa*bb)

   distance_sq=np.minimum(distance_sq,np.where(valid,dot_last(residual,residual),np.inf))

def dotvec(a,b): return np.einsum('...i,...i->...',a,b)
def tri_pair_distances(first,second):
    count=len(first)*len(second)
    aa=np.repeat(first,len(second),axis=0)
    bb=np.tile(second,(len(first),1,1))
    best=np.full(count,np.inf)
    def point_faces(points,faces):
        origin=faces[:,0]; edge_u=faces[:,1]-origin; edge_v=faces[:,2]-origin
        normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); norm2=dotvec(normal,normal)
        offset=points-origin
        signed=dotvec(offset,normal)
        projection=points-normal*np.divide(signed,norm2,out=np.zeros_like(signed),where=norm2>0)[:,None]
        return projection,signed,norm2
    def inside(points,faces):
        edge_u=faces[:,1]-faces[:,0]; edge_v=faces[:,2]-faces[:,0]; offset=points-faces[:,0]
        normal=np.cross(edge_u,edge_v); denom=dotvec(normal,normal)
        bary_u=np.divide(dotvec(np.cross(offset,edge_v),normal),denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
        bary_v=np.divide(dotvec(np.cross(edge_u,offset),normal),denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
        return (bary_u>=-1e-13)&(bary_v>=-1e-13)&(bary_u+bary_v<=1+1e-13)
    for source,target in ((aa,bb),(bb,aa)):
        for vertex in range(3):
            projected,signed,norm2=point_faces(source[:,vertex],target)
            dist2=np.divide(signed*signed,norm2,out=np.full(count,np.inf),where=norm2>0)
            best=np.minimum(best,np.where(inside(projected,target),dist2,np.inf))
        normal=np.cross(target[:,1]-target[:,0],target[:,2]-target[:,0])
        for edge in range(3):
            start=source[:,edge]; end=source[:,(edge+1)%3]; direction=end-start
            denom=dotvec(direction,normal)
            param=np.divide(dotvec(target[:,0]-start,normal),denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom!=0)
            hit=start+np.nan_to_num(param)[:,None]*direction
            intersects=(param>=0)&(param<=1)&inside(hit,target)
            best=np.where(intersects,0,best)
    for edge_a in range(3):
        start_a=aa[:,edge_a]; direction_a=aa[:,(edge_a+1)%3]-start_a
        for edge_b in range(3):
            start_b=bb[:,edge_b]; direction_b=bb[:,(edge_b+1)%3]-start_b
            offset=start_a-start_b
            length_a=dotvec(direction_a,direction_a); length_b=dotvec(direction_b,direction_b)
            mixed=dotvec(direction_a,direction_b); offset_a=dotvec(direction_a,offset); offset_b=dotvec(direction_b,offset)
            denom=dotvec(np.cross(direction_a,direction_b),np.cross(direction_a,direction_b))
            param_a=np.divide(mixed*offset_b-length_b*offset_a,denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
            param_b=np.divide(length_a*offset_b-mixed*offset_a,denom,out=np.full(count,np.nan),where=denom>0)
            delta=offset+np.nan_to_num(param_a)[:,None]*direction_a-np.nan_to_num(param_b)[:,None]*direction_b
            best=np.minimum(best,np.where((param_a>=0)&(param_a<=1)&(param_b>=0)&(param_b<=1),dotvec(delta,delta),np.inf))
            for endpoint in (0,1):
                point=start_a+endpoint*direction_a
                param=np.clip(np.divide(dotvec(point-start_b,direction_b),length_b,out=np.zeros(count),where=length_b>0),0,1)
                delta=point-start_b-param[:,None]*direction_b
                best=np.minimum(best,dotvec(delta,delta))
                point=start_b+endpoint*direction_b
                param=np.clip(np.divide(dotvec(point-start_a,direction_a),length_a,out=np.zeros(count),where=length_a>0),0,1)
                delta=point-start_a-param[:,None]*direction_a
                best=np.minimum(best,dotvec(delta,delta))
    return np.sqrt(best).reshape(len(first),len(second))
